what_the_stage3_deltas_store_is: Stage-3 S3-6 iteration 3, the coverage-gated APPLICATION policy (docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-general-scenario-diagnostic.md and docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r02-verdict.md): the SAME released stage3-deltas-v2 store CELL-2 flew -- same release, same snapshot, same 200 values, same builder policy, same facet rule, same caps -- applied on FEWER ROWS. The CELL-2 verdict read a content gain wherever the store has reach (arm minus twin: news +7.4, alarm +4.2, qa +4.2, weather +4.1 pp SLU) and a loss on the strata it does not reach; the derangement twin reproduced that loss, which makes it a FORM cost of carrying a supply rather than the content of any delta. Iteration 3 therefore changes neither the store nor the selection but the APPLICATION: each candidate-bound route declares scenario_gate majority-candidate-scenario-not-in-v1 over general, alarm, music, social, iot, play and news, and a row whose projected Perception candidates have a majority scenario in that set takes no supply step at that node at all (receipted as a delta_supply skip with reason scenario-gate-closed plus the majority scenario label, and as an open/closed decision on delta_scenario_gate). On every other row the supply is byte-identical to the ungated route. THE VENUE IS NEW: the gated set was chosen on TRAIN Fold A, and this cell reads it on the fresh DEV-2000-ADDED roster (decision 99 replicate venue), which makes this the FIRST out-of-fold read of the Stage-3 delta line. What holds this cell is a root admission decision, not wiring. THIS IS THE TWIN ARM: the released store at this namespace is the seeded derangement (seed 20260922, scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_twin.py) of version 2 own authored document -- same 200 statements, same node distribution, the same authored token count (3,001) and the same per-row facet-count multiset, with the attachment moved as whole tuples. 13 of the 200 rows land on an equal facet set by arithmetic (26 distinct intents over 200 rows) and are reported, not refused. THE GATE IS THE ARM GATE, unchanged: the twin therefore isolates what the gated supply FORM costs and pays on exactly the rows the gate leaves open. It is the FORM control for the CELL-3 read and decides attribution, never admission.
